# RoboFiesta'26

> RoboFiesta'26 is RVITM's student robotics festival in Bangalore, India. Its theme is “Where Circuits Come Alive,” and its primary message is “Build. Battle. Break Limits.”

## Official facts

- Dates: 16–18 October 2026
- Venue: RVITM, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Organizer: RVITM Robotics Community
- Audience: student builders, coders, creators, players, and teams
- Format: in-person college festival
- Prize details: TBA
- Registration fee: TBA; consult the official rulebooks when published
